title: Cross-Platform
concept: Build XIOM projects for Windows, macOS, and Linux from a single codebase — using conditional compilation and platform-specific APIs.
why: Your users are on different platforms. XIOM's LLVM backend compiles to all major OSes from the same source — with conditional compilation for platform differences.
tips: Use #[cfg] for platform-specific code — don't check the OS at runtime
Abstract platform differences behind interfaces — keep business logic platform-agnostic
Test on ALL platforms in CI — one platform working doesn't mean all work
Use `xiom doctor` on each platform to verify toolchain setup before building
common_mistakes: Using platform-specific APIs without #[cfg] — code doesn't compile on other platforms
Assuming case-insensitive filesystem — your code might work on Windows but fail on Linux
